marca.frasePrincipal: From invisible worth to perceived worth.
marca.fraseAncora: Being excellent isn't enough. You have to be seen.

peca.gate: Piece 9 of 9 · Where I reach you

retomada.aviso: I picked up where you left off. Nothing was lost.

painelDesktop.rotulo: The pieces of your pattern, taking shape as you go

abertura.corpo: A few questions, under three minutes. At the end you get a diagnosis made to measure, not a generic quiz result. Getting here already traced the first piece.

espelho.titulo: Which of these sentences echoes in you the most, right now?
espelho.sub: Pick the one that hurts most, not the one that sounds best.

cards.patricia: I open the packed closet… and can't find anything to wear.
cards.camila: I deliver more than plenty of people who show up and charge more than I do.
cards.carla: My clinic delivers a high-standard result. My image, not always.

espelho.rotulagem: Plenty of people who live this also felt ashamed to admit it, {nome}. Let's take it step by step.

situacaoTitulo.patricia: And where did it show up last?
situacaoTitulo.camila: And when was the last time it cost you something?
situacaoTitulo.carla: And where did that gap show most?

patricia: In front of the closet, running late, changing clothes three times
At an event where I didn't know what was appropriate
In a photo someone posted without telling me
On an ordinary day, just the usual tiredness of always looking the same
camila: In a meeting where I knew more and they spoke to someone else
On a proposal I lost to someone less prepared
An invitation that never came, and I found out later
On a project where my work shone and I didn't
carla: When a patient compared my price with someone who delivers less
In a photo of the office that didn't look like my standard
At a conference where colleagues with lesser results had more presence
When I realised my image didn't back up my price increase

titulo.patricia: If, in 30 days, one thing changed in you for good, what would it be?
titulo.camila: If in 30 days one thing changed in how you're seen professionally, what would it be?
titulo.carla: If in 30 days your image started to communicate the real level of your work, what would change first?

q3.sub: Write it your way, {nome}. This is the sentence I'll give back to you at the end.

precificacao.sub: Drag until it's close to real. No one but you sees these numbers.
precificacao.precoAtual: Today, how much do you charge for your main service?
precificacao.precoDesejado: And how much should it be worth?
precificacao.precoDesejadoNota: It can't be below what you already charge.
precificacao.volumeMensal: On average, how many of those do you do per month?
precificacao.calculoTitulo: Based on what you told me:
precificacao.porMes: By your own schedule, {mes} a month.
precificacao.semGap: Your target came out equal to what you already charge. Drag the second measure to where it should be.
precificacao.nota: This math is yours, {nome}. Your own numbers made it. No one is taking this money. It just isn't being charged.
precificacao.aguardando: Move the three measures to see your math.

guardaRoupa.sub: Drag until it's close to real. No one but you sees these numbers.
guardaRoupa.pctUsado: What share of your wardrobe do you actually wear?
guardaRoupa.valorParado: Over the last 12 months, how much do you think you spent on pieces that stayed on the hanger?
guardaRoupa.calculoTitulo: Based on what you told me:
guardaRoupa.usado: {pct}% of your wardrobe works for you today.
guardaRoupa.adormecido: The other {pct}% didn't disappear. They're dormant.
guardaRoupa.valor: {valor} in pieces still hanging there, waiting for someone to say what they go with.
guardaRoupa.nota: It's not about owning more clothes, {nome}. It's about waking up what's already yours.
guardaRoupa.aguardando: Move the two measures to see your math.

sub.patricia: Close your eyes. You walk into a room. How do people see you?
sub.camila: You walk into the meeting. Before you say a word, what has your presence already said?
sub.carla: A new patient arrives. Has your image already confirmed the price you charge?

futuro.titulo: Six months from now, when you leave a room, how do you want to be described?
futuro.restante: {n, plural, =0 {No picks left} one {One more, if you want} other {# more words}}

q7.titulo: What have you already tried to fix this?
opcoes: I bought clothes and new things on my own
I followed ready-made tips from influencers
I've considered therapy or self-esteem work

q8.titulo: By when do you want this sorted?
opcoes: I want to start this week
I want to sort it in the next 2 to 4 weeks
I want to sort it this quarter
No rush, just gathering information for now

titulo.precificacao: Based on what you told me, that difference adds up to {ano} over twelve months. Which investment range makes sense for you to start changing it?
titulo.guardaRoupa: Based on what you told me, there's {valor} lying dormant in your wardrobe. Which investment range makes sense so this stops repeating?

q9.tituloSemGap: Which investment range makes sense for you to start changing this?
q9.sub: It's not my price. It's your opening ceiling.

balao.de7a10k: With this margin, you can go deep in one go.

audio.consentimento: Your audio becomes text only to build your diagnosis. Once transcribed, we don't keep the file. OK to record?
audio.erro: I couldn't record just now. You can type.

confirmacao.corpo: I just need to confirm what I understood. Takes 30 seconds, not 3 minutes.
confirmacao.rodape: You've already told me most of this. Just confirm what I understood correctly. Takes 30 seconds.
confirmacao.linkInvalido: This link isn't valid anymore. No problem, you can answer right here just the same.

b1.titulo: {nome}, here's what I heard, and what I see.
b1.epigrafe: Being excellent isn't enough. You have to be seen.

b3.titulo: The two halves of the same person.

b4.notacao: The measuring tape of the turn
b4.titulo: Three stations, measured on your ruler.
b4.fecho: It's not a product; it's the map between who you are and who you decided to be.

patricia.percebida: You stop dressing on autopilot. The right capsule, the right colours, the basics no one taught you.
patricia.referencia: Your image starts telling your story instead of hiding it. People notice before you speak.
patricia.inevitavel: You walk into any room knowing you belong there. You stop wondering what to wear. You just live.

camila.percebida: Your competence gets a shop window. You stop being the best no one sees.
camila.referencia: You start getting invited into the right rooms before you have to explain yourself.
camila.inevitavel: Your name becomes shorthand for what you do. Perception finally catches up with merit.

carla.percebida: Your image starts communicating the price you already charge.
carla.referencia: Patients arrive pre-convinced of your level; the conversation starts before the appointment.
carla.inevitavel: Your clinic becomes a reference. Price stops being the first objection.

b5.corpo: Generic style consulting swaps you for someone else: an archetype, a palette, a manual. The French methodology does the opposite. It reads what's already there and translates it. You don't become someone else. You start being read as who you already are.
b5.corpo2: That's why the work starts by measuring, not buying. First the reading, then the language, and only then the piece.

b6.corpo: Before you, {numero} other women have already crossed this.
b6.placeholder: Space reserved for testimonials and credentials. Nothing here was invented: there is no real material available until Renilza provides hers.
